metadata.question: Was the concentration of tropospheric nitrogen dioxide over Brooklyn, New York lower between October 1-23, 2021 compared to the same period in 2019 and 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: Sentinel-5P TROPOMI NO2 ("COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2") - Dates: Oct 1-23 for 2018, 2019, and 2021 - Location: Brooklyn, New York (approximate center around -73.95, 40.65) 2. Masking strategy: - Use qa_value >= 0.75 to filter high-quality NO2 data - Focus on tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density band 3. Logic: - Calculate mean NO2 for each period - Check for empty collections (C1) - Check for zero valid pixels after masking (C2) - Check for invalid results (C3) - Compare 2021 vs both 2018 and 2019 - Answer A if 2021 < both 2018 and 2019 - Answer B otherwise ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const brooklyn = ee.Geometry.Point([-73.95, 40.65]).buffer(5000); // 5km buffer around Brooklyn center const periods = { '2018': ['2018-10-01', '2018-10-24'], '2019': ['2019-10-01', '2019-10-24'], '2021': ['2021-10-01', '2021-10-24'] }; // 2. Data Acquisition & Check const collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density'); const results = {}; for (const [year, dates] of Object.entries(periods)) { const filtered = collection .filterDate(dates[0], dates[1]) .filterBounds(brooklyn); const count = filtered.size().getInfo(); console.log(`${year} Images: ${count}`); if (count === 0) { console.log(`No data for ${year}.`); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing with QA filtering const masked = filtered.map(function(img) { const qa = img.select('qa_value'); const mask = qa.gte(0.75); return img.updateMask(mask); }); const composite = masked.mean(); // Check valid pixels const pixelCount = composite.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: brooklyn, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log(`No valid pixels for ${year} after QA filtering.`); console.log("C2"); return; } // 4. Calculation const meanNO2 = composite.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: brooklyn, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); results[year] = { value: meanNO2, pixels: pixelCount }; console.log(`${year}: NO2=${meanNO2 ? meanNO2.toExponential(3) : 'null'} mol/m², Pixels=${pixelCount}`); } // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (results['2018'].value === null || results['2019'].value === null || results['2021'].value === null) { console.log("Calculation failed for one or more years."); console.log("C3"); return; } const lower2018 = results['2021'].value < results['2018'].value; const lower2019 = results['2021'].value < results['2019'].value; console.log(`\n2021 < 2018: ${lower2018}, 2021 < 2019: ${lower2019}`); if (lower2018 && lower2019) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
